messages:
asha: Quick design check — attaching the compare grid screenshot: https://redwood-assets/internal/compare-grid-v3.png  Need feedback on three things: 1) legend icon affordance, 2) performance badge contrast (dark mode), 3) copy for pinning/version state.

miguel: Saw it, looks tight. badges are borderline low-contrast on dark bg, small caps make it worse. Fails AA for 12px text. :eyes:

priya: Copy nit: current label is 'Pinned' on rows and 'Pin version' on the menu — inconsistent. We should pick one and run it across. I vote for "Pinned version" for the state and "Pin version" for the action.

zoe: Legend icons are hard to parse at 16px. The flame icon kind of reads as 'cost' to me not 'throughput'. Could we add a 1-2 word label inline (e.g., 'Latency', 'Throughput', 'Cost') or a tooltip on hover? Keyboard users also need to reach the legend items.

miguel: Agree with labels. Also suggest we don't rely solely on color for the badge meaning — add a glyph or initial (e.g., 'L' for latency) for accessibility and quick scannability.

designbot: automated-a11y-scan: badge contrast failures detected on dark theme for the following hex combos: badge-text #ffffff on badge-bg #6b7280 -> ratio 3.8:1 (target >=4.5:1 for 12px). Recommended adjustments: increase bg darkness to #4b5563 or boost text weight/size.

asha: Good call @miguel @zoe. Two quick mock options: A) keep icons + compact 1-word labels under the header, B) drop icons, show 2-letter monogram + full label on hover. Which is faster to implement?

miguel: B is simpler in CSS/markup — use pseudo-element with initials. No SVG swaps. Also easier to theme for dark mode.

priya: Wording proposal for menu/action states: action: `Pin version`, undo: `Unpin version`, persistent state: `Pinned (v1.4)` or `Pinned version: v1.4`. Prefer `Pinned (v1.4)` for compactness.

zoe: UX nit: If a user pins a version, where does that appear in the compare table? Should the pinned column be sticky on the left or flagged visually? Recommend sticky + 1px dashed border + `Pinned` badge. Also keyboard focus should allow toggling pin via Enter/Space on focused row action.

miguel: Implementation note: sticky column is heavier but doable. For initial pass we can add a left-most flag column and sticky later. Need product sign-off though.

asha: Action items: 1) I'll update the mock with B (initials + label on hover) and stronger badge colors for dark mode. 2) @priya will finalize microcopy for pin states. 3) @miguel will prototyping CSS for initials badges + keyboard focus. 4) I'll open a tiny PR with CSS tokens and the new vars. Target: EOD Friday.

priya: I'll put copy suggestions in the doc and include examples for the tooltip and aria-labels.

miguel: I'll sketch the CSS snippet and paste in the PR. Example quick snippet:```css
/* initials badge */
.compare-legend .badge::before { content: attr(data-initials); display:inline-block; width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:4px; text-align:center; font-weight:600; }
```

asha: Thanks all — one more accessibility nit: ensure the badge is reachable in tab order or has an aria-describedby linking to the legend. Not optional.

zoe: :thumbsup: from me.
